fields.statement: Verifier, attempt 5, at d5cd0e9: make check exits 0 (fmt-check, vet, go test ./..., self-check). go test -count=1 ./cmd/rhiza -run 'TestScripts/(run-ship-change|run-ship-signoff|run-ship-change-fail|describe-golden)$' passes. run-ship-change runs the built-in ship-change via run start with fake rex/claude/gh on two leaves (second depends-on first): both built and verified in order, review's two checks ran, PR #7 created once with the run summary as body, run stopped signoff_waiting with no pr merge until rhiza run approve, then land, squash merge pinned to the landed head, main-green and close-out pass; a clone of the pushed PR branch passes rhiza check. TestShipChangeBuiltin asserts the step order with render and render-pr and that ship-change.toml has no shipit; the toml has no ship check --pr-open. Read the diff: render-pr command step sits between review and open-pr with max_visits 3, matching the signoff loop, so request-changes cycles render before each push. Mutation in a scratch clone (review.on.pass straight to open-pr in run-ship-signoff) makes rhiza check on the re-pushed clone fail, so the new check guards the attempt-4 QA finding.
